meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Caustic Surge
journal.description: Burning Venoms explode when destroyed, inflicting 100009 Fire damage to all players3 sec. This effect stacks. [.]

journal.title: Dripping Fangs
journal.description: Vashnik bites into his current target, inflicting 2083517 Physical damage and an additional 250022 Nature damage every 2 sec for 32 sec. Increases Physical damage taken by 200%. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Imbibe
journal.description:
Vashnik draws power from two nearby fountains, infusing himself with their power and gaining an application of Toxic Vapor.

Each fountain bursts forth in an expulsion of toxins and creates living venoms that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity.

journal.title: Malignant Catalyst
journal.description: Vashnik congeals an orb of venom above the Malignant Cavity and then explodes it, inflicting 320862 Nature damage to all players and launching Catalytic Bile.

journal.title: Malignance
journal.description: The totem sends a wave of poison, inflicting 666725 Nature damage and an additional 208352 Nature damage every 2 sec for 1 min to all players. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Malignant Burst
journal.description: Living venoms burst upon reaching the Malignant Cavity, inflicting 1666813 Nature damage to all players and an additional 333363 Nature damage every 3 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.
